verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official HubSpot MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to CRM data (contacts, deals, engagements). It also documents a separate CLI-based Developer MCP server for agentic development tools, and a probe confirmed the official MCP documentation page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and evidence of setup details such as the auth flow, transport, and tool list.
